segments.text: Dropppy, the productivity tool for Mac OS. It combines five tools into one slick package. Notch shelf for hiding files under your webcam, a floating
basket that pops up anywhere, and a clipboard manager that remembers everything you copy. New features, check a media player right in your notch and
custom volume and brightness HUDs that look way better than the default.
